details: [Passive] Reworked -> VTOL Jets: Jetpack cooldown and fly speed.
[Passive] Buff -> VTOL Jets: Recharge delay significantly reduced (8 → 2.5 sec)
[Passive] Buff -> VTOL Jets: Recharge time significantly reduced (~10.9 → 3 sec)
[Passive] Adjust -> VTOL Jets: Fuel doesn’t start recharging until you touch ground
[Passive] Nerf -> VTOL Jets: EMP effects drain jetpack fuel
[Passive] Nerf -> VTOL Jets: Reduced initial speed boost for first 0.5 sec (~25% faster → ~5% slower)
[Passive] Nerf -> VTOL Jets: Total fuel reduced (8 → 6 sec)
[Passive] Nerf -> VTOL Jets: Initial fuel consumption slightly increased
[Tactical] Buff -> Missile Swarm: Removed self damage and stun effect
[Tactical] Buff -> Missile Swarm: Added short (1.5 sec) full body scan on hit
[Tactical] Adjust -> Missile Swarm: Tac damage now puts movement passives on cooldown (like other EMP effects)
[Tactical] Buff -> Missile Swarm: Removed 5 seconds of cooldown (30 sec → 25 sec)
[Tactical] Buff -> Missile Swarm: Removed vertical clearance firing restriction
[Tactical] Buff -> Missile Swarm: Improved missile pathing to work better in some situations such as low clearance situations (firing indoors or at targets under a bridge)
[Tactical] Buff -> Missile Swarm: Increased max range (~100m → 125m)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Increased launch height 15% (integrated Afterburners upgrade)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Reduced cooldown by 30 seconds (3 min → 2.5 min)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Reduced delay before takeoff (2 sec → 1.5 sec)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Slightly reduced time slowly rising before takeoff (1.83 sec → 1.33 sec)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Removed self cancel cooldown penalty
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Reduced damage cooldown penalty (54 sec → 30 sec)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Allow tactical to be fired when skydiving (except from drop ship)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: Land faster when skydiving (spend less time slow falling near ground)
[Perks] Removed -> Afterburners: Removed (included by default)
[Perks] Adjust -> Eyes in the Sky: Moved to Level 2
[Perks] Adjust -> Full Coverage: Changes missile swarm pattern to 4x5 (was 3x5)
[Perks] Removed -> Full Tank: Removed (jetpack reworked)
[Perks] New -> Supersonic: Ultimate launch time reduced ~50%
[Perks] Adjust -> Aerial Expert: Improves jetpack horizontal speed, significantly improves handling, decreases initial fuel consumption, slightly reduces total fuel.

[Passive] Buff -> Battle Modder: Adds additional effect to old passive (Modded Loader). Cover walls permanently gain health as Rampart gains Evo Levels. Wall health increase by 200 per Evo level (400 → 800 at max level). Shield health increased by 25 per Evo level (175 → 225 at max level).
[Tactical] Reworked -> Amped Cover: Adds amped shield roof to wall

[Tactical] Reworked -> Amped Cover: Walls can now be charged by doing damage through the amped shield or by having the wall be damaged by enemies. Wall charge is converted to a sprint boost by going over the wall. Sprint boost is automatically given to nearby teammates when the wall is destroyed.
[Tactical] Reworked -> Amped Cover: Damage to wall is stored at 25%, while damage through amped shield is stored at 100%
[Tactical] Nerf -> Amped Cover: Health while wall building reduced (120 → 100)
[Tactical] Nerf -> Amped Cover: Amped shield arc star damage multiplier removed (1.5x → 1.0x)
[Tactical] Nerf -> Amped Cover: Wall frag grenade damage multiplier increased (1.0x → 2.0x)
[Perks] Removed -> Ultimate Cooldown
[Perks] Removed -> Bandolier
[Perks] New -> Combat reserve: Bigger ammo stacks, extra grenades slots, access red weapon supply bins
[Perks] New -> Locked and Loaded: gain faster reloads and infinite ammo when behind amped cover and shield is in tact
[Perks] Removed -> Amped Reloads
[Perks] New -> Rebuild Module: Amped cover will regen health and rebuild shield section after not being damaged for a period of time
[Tactical] Buff -> Gravity Lift: Increased lift speed (300 → 375)
[Tactical] Buff -> Gravity Lift: Increased hover time at top of lift (0.5 sec → 1.5 sec)
[Tactical] Buff -> Gravity Lift: Reduced cooldown by 5 seconds (25 sec → 20 sec)
[Tactical] Buff -> Gravity Lift: Reduced delay before cooldown starts 8 sec (10 sec → 2 sec)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Black Hole: Reduced cooldown by 30 seconds (3.5 min → 3 min)
[Ultimate] Buff -> Black Hole: Increased health (175 → 225)
[Perks] Removed -> Ultimate Cooldown & Tactical Cooldown
[Perks] New -> Gravity Boots: Press crouch while in the air to fall much more quickly
[Perks] New -> Newt Scoot: Press jump after exiting gravity lift to glide
[Perks] Removed -> Combat Reserve
[Perks] New -> Knock Expert: gain tactical charge on knocks.
[Tactical] Nerf -> Shadow Pounce: Reduced the maximum possible velocity of Revenants Shadow Pounce
